preconditions.name: committed_class_axis_exercisable_both_arms
preconditions.description: frac of P2 ticks with >= 2 candidate first-action classes exceeds floor on a majority of seeds in BOTH arms. SAME-statistic family as C2 (class multiplicity bounds class entropy).
preconditions.control: SP-CEM multi-class candidate pool, both arms

preconditions.name: gapa_consumed_summary_divergence_both_arms
preconditions.description: consumed cand_world_summaries (e2.world_forward) per-candidate SPREAD clears the floor on a majority of seeds in BOTH arms -- the class bias is non-degenerate. Same range statistic the 649 GAP-A readiness asserts.
preconditions.control: ARM_OFF + ARM_ON: SD-056 e2 trained online in P0; candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward

preconditions.name: gapa_consumed_summary_bounded
preconditions.description: consumed-summary spread stayed below the 643a explosion ceiling (SD-056 online-training numerical stability; rollout-norm clamp ON).

preconditions.name: arm_on_rule_field_differentiated_and_matured
preconditions.description: ARM_ON CandidateRuleField minted >= CRF_MIN_MINTED distinct rules AND fired a non-zero rule_state on >= CRF_FRAC_ACTIVE_FLOOR of P2 ticks (the crf_persist-matured pool clears the 0.30 floor the 654 per-episode cold-start could not), on a majority of ARM_ON seeds. Below-floor => substrate not matured => substrate_not_ready_requeue.

preconditions.name: propagation_non_vacuity_arm_on_bias_differs_from_arm_off
preconditions.description: paired-by-seed |mean_lateral_pfc_bias_abs(ARM_ON) - mean_lateral_pfc_bias_abs(ARM_OFF)| > floor on a majority of seeds. The trained head + matured field produce a DIFFERENT bias than the legacy collapsed source -- the 654 seed-42 byte-identical (~4.4e-5) propagation washout did not recur. Below-floor => vacuous propagation => substrate_not_ready_requeue (do NOT score the falsifier). Supported by the within-ARM_ON rule_state counterfactual delta (zeroing rule_state changes the bias).
preconditions.control: paired ARM_ON vs ARM_OFF mean lateral_pfc bias on the matched stack

preconditions.name: mech448_demotion_lever_live_and_excluding_both_arms
preconditions.description: The MECH-448 f_eligibility-demotion conversion constant (matched on BOTH arms) is ACTIVE on >= DEMOTION_ACTIVE_FRAC_FLOOR of P2 ticks AND it ACTUALLY EXCLUDES on the divergent e2_world_forward pool (mean f_eligibility_excluded_count > EXCLUDED_COUNT_FLOOR), on a majority of seeds in BOTH arms. An all-admit envelope (excluded_count==0; a flat-F pool) means the demotion did nothing -> the conversion constant is vacuous => substrate_not_ready_requeue (do NOT score the falsifier), NEVER a false weakens. Mirrors the V3-EXQ-689d READINESS(c) non-degeneracy gate.
preconditions.control: f_demotion envelope active-frac + excluded_count on both arms (matched lever)

preconditions.name: mech449_active_nogo_live_and_suppressing_both_arms
preconditions.description: The MECH-449 Go/No-Go eligibility constitution (matched on BOTH arms) is ACTIVE on >= NOGO_ACTIVE_FRAC_FLOOR of P2 ticks AND it ACTUALLY SUPPRESSES -- removes candidates from the F-eligible set (mean per-tick go_nogo_n_safety_nogo + go_nogo_n_soft_applied > NOGO_SUPPRESSED_FLOOR; the soft path is the MECH-260 perseveration No-Go fed by the dACC recency-share vector with use_dacc=True), on a majority of seeds in BOTH arms. An inert No-Go (nothing suppressed; the perseveration axis never crosses gng_perseveration_floor) means the active opponency leg did nothing -> the conversion constant is vacuous => substrate_not_ready_requeue (do NOT score the falsifier), NEVER a false weakens. Mirrors the V3-EXQ-689g go_nogo-actually-suppresses non-degeneracy gate.
preconditions.control: Go/No-Go constitution active-frac + suppressed-count on both arms (matched lever)

preconditions.name: lateral_pfc_route_range_supra_floor_and_sample_adequate_both_arms
preconditions.description: V3-EXQ-851 (ARC-062 P-A erratum fix): modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc' identity-routes the SD-033a rule-apprehension bias (_bdc_lpfc, the SAME channel use_candidate_rule_field differentiates) into _modulatory_accum. On a majority of seeds in BOTH arms (routing is a matched constant, not swept -- unlike 791a's single ARM_1): (a) the routed range's mean clears ROUTE_RANGE_SEED_FLOOR; (b) the GENUINE fresh-selection sample (latch-cleared, 791a pattern) clears FRESH_SELECT_FLOOR (cadence-derived worst-case: nominal P2 window ticks / beta_rate_max_steps); (c) the fresh-select YIELD clears FRESH_SELECT_YIELD_FLOOR (the same cadence bound as a truncation-invariant fraction of the observed window). An unrouted or under-sampled channel means the C2 committed-class DV cannot be attributed to routing => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a false weakens. Mirrors the V3-EXQ-791a route-range + sample-adequacy P0 gates.
preconditions.control: modulatory_channel_route_range + n_p2_fresh_select on both arms (matched lever)
